description: This file contains a JavaScript module that defines underscore.js's templating functions, initializes Google Analytics, and includes functions for fetching files and issues, as well as a Learn class for dynamically inserting content based on JSON data.

classes.name: Learn
classes.description: A class for fetching and displaying framework-specific information and issues in the DOM.

methods.name: Learn.prototype.append
methods.description: Inserts a templated aside element into the DOM with framework info.

methods.name: Learn.prototype.fetchIssueCount
methods.description: Fetches and displays the count of open issues from GitHub API.
